strategies.name: htf_fvg_tap_with_1m_ifvg_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: After 9:30 a.m. New York time, identify the draw on liquidity, then wait for a 5-minute or 15-minute fair value gap to form in the direction of that draw. When price taps that higher-timeframe fair value gap, drop to the 1-minute chart and enter on inversion of the 1-minute fair value gap(s) after a
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop beyond the recent sweep/high-low used for the entry. Target either the draw on liquidity or, preferably, a fixed 1:2 risk-reward; move stop to break even once the closest post-entry liquidity level is taken out.

variants.timeframe_note: 5-minute or 15-minute higher-timeframe fair value gap; 1-minute confirmation
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: After price taps the higher-timeframe gap, wait for 1-minute liquidity sweep and bearish inversion of the bullish 1m FVG
variants.target_note: Target draw on liquidity or fixed 1:2; move to break even after nearest low is taken
variants.transcript_quote: once price closes below this IFVG you want to take a short position right away and you want to put your stop above the high and you can target the drn

variants.timeframe_note: 5-minute or 15-minute higher-timeframe fair value gap; 1-minute confirmation
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: After price taps the higher-timeframe gap, wait for 1-minute liquidity sweep and bullish inversion of the bearish 1m FVG
variants.target_note: Fixed 1:2 shown; move to break even after nearest high/closest liquidity is taken
variants.transcript_quote: we have inversed the 1 minute gap. We take our entry. We put our stop below these bodies and we go for 1 to2

result.enumeration_note: One strategy skeleton is taught and demonstrated in both bearish and bullish directions; these are compatible directional variants of the same higher-timeframe FVG tap plus 1-minute inversion model.
